incompleteRestart.androidObservation: Matching sample package had Android exit reason OTHER KILLS BY SYSTEM / INVALID START. Previous replay process recorded PACKAGE UPDATED.

summary.units: Times in milliseconds. Resident memory in MiB. Quantiles [p50,p95,p99] are medians of the four within-run nearest-rank quantiles. The median of four is the mean of the two middle observations.

rebuiltAfterMirrorSupport.comparison: Every non-directory APK entry compared by path and SHA-256 with the measured artifact, including manifest, DEX, native libraries, scenes and notices. Signing envelopes can differ between builds.
